summary_md: **Gumbii.Digital ([@GumbiiDigital](https://x.com/GumbiiDigital/status/2116572096377594065))** updates the TensorFold Engine challenge: after 24 hours, community optimizations of **Qwen 3.8 27B** run 158.6% faster on DGX Spark (decode 13.7 to 41.5 tok/s) and 60% faster on Apple Silicon ([cuda.fast](https://www.yukon.org/cudafast?benchmark=nemotron35&platform=cuda), [mlx.fast](https://www.yukon.org/mlxfast?benchmark=nemotron35&platform=mlx)).

referenced_urls.title: cuda.fast — Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, faster with speculative decode
mlx.fast — Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, faster with speculative decode

relevance: Big DGX Spark speedups for a ~30B model.
